objective: Convert the Phase 19 multi-pass modeling policy from documentation into machine-enforced bridge invariants, while preserving backward compatibility for existing single-pass and non-modeling tasks.
instructions: Read Phase 18 and Phase 19 workflow, templates, payload runner, bridge_cli.py, and evidence before changing anything.
This is control-plane enforcement only. Do not modify Rhino/MCP runtime implementation files and do not execute geometry-changing Rhino code.
Extend .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report so controller-authored Rhino payload provenance is actually checked when a task has .bridge/payloads/<task-id>/manifest.json.

For any controller-authored payload task, verify the manifest and rhino.py exist at the reported result commit, recompute SHA-256, require it to match manifest.sha256, require author_role=controller, and require report.result_commit to equal the current work commit being verified.

When local_modeling_authorized is false or absent, verify the operator did not modify .bridge/payloads/<task-id>/rhino.py or manifest.json relative to report.base_commit. If either changed on the operator branch, verify-report must fail with a clear unauthorized-local-modeling/provenance error.
Do not infer local modeling permission from operator identity. Claude and Codex are both execution-only unless the active request or manifest explicitly authorizes local modeling.

For manifests carrying multi-pass metadata, enforce lineage: modeling_run_id non-empty; pass_index positive integer; pass_kind one of foundation, correction, detail_qa, hotfix, single_pass; requires_controller_review_after boolean when present.
For pass_index=1/foundation, reject parent lineage fields if they claim a prior modeling pass unless explicitly documented as a hotfix/import case.
For pass_index>1, require parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, and parent_result_commit.

Resolve the parent from the base commit, not from untrusted operator modifications. Require the parent report to exist in report.base_commit, require its result_commit to equal parent_result_commit, require the parent payload manifest to exist in report.base_commit, require its sha256 to equal parent_payload_sha256, require the same modeling_run_id, and require current pass_index=parent pass_index+1.

Treat presence of the parent report on report.base_commit as the machine signal that the controller has reviewed/merged that parent pass before the next pass begins. Do not require a new protocol state or version bump.
Standardize completed multi-pass evidence at .bridge/evidence/<task-id>/pass-evaluation.json. Update the workflow and templates so future multi-pass tasks use that exact filename.

For completed multi-pass tasks, verify-report must require pass-evaluation.json at report.result_commit and validate task_id, modeling_run_id, pass_index, pass_kind, executed_payload_sha256, and operator_recommendation_scope='evidence_only' against the manifest.

Extend rhino-pass-evaluation-v1.json with explicit provenance fields: local_modeling_used, local_modeling_authorized, payload_modified_by_operator, and provenance_check. Defaults/examples should represent the normal controller-authored workflow.

verify-report must reject a multi-pass evaluation claiming local_modeling_used=true when authorization is false, payload_modified_by_operator=true when authorization is false, or executed_payload_sha256 differs from the manifest.

Add a non-mutating bridge CLI command named next-pass-context PARENT_TASK_ID that reads the parent report + manifest from the current checkout and prints JSON containing modeling_run_id, next_pass_index, parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit, and parent_pass_kind. This is a convenience helper only and must not author geometry.

Add deterministic fixture-based tests under tests/ or .bridge/tests/ that cover: valid foundation pass, valid correction lineage, SHA mismatch, operator payload modification without authorization, missing parent report, wrong parent result commit, wrong modeling_run_id, non-sequential pass_index, missing pass evaluation, wrong executed SHA, wrong operator_recommendation_scope, unauthorized local_modeling_used, and backward-compatible non-modeling/single-pass report verification.
Tests must not depend on live Rhino or network access. Use temporary Git repositories/fixtures if necessary.
Update MULTI_PASS_RHINO.md, payloads/README.md, reviewer.md, and operator.md only as needed to document that these invariants are now enforced by verify-report.
Keep AI_ORIENTATION.md concise; add no new detail there unless needed to correct an inconsistency.
Do not change protocol_version from 0.3. Additive enforcement is expected to remain backward-compatible.
Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase20-001/multipass-enforcement.json documenting every invariant, failure mode, test, files changed, and known limitations.

Validate python3 -m py_compile .bridge/bridge_cli.py; run the full new fixture test suite; run the existing _example payload dry-run; validate all edited JSON with json.load; run git diff --check; verify protected Rhino/MCP runtime files are unchanged.
Commit implementation/evidence as the work commit and capture RESULT_COMMIT.

Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase20-001.json with ack exactly BRIDGE-PHASE20-MULTIPASS-ENFORCEMENT-20260924-94C2E7-OPERATOR-ACK, exact base_commit, RESULT_COMMIT, and branch operator/bridge-phase20-001.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase20-001 and require REPORT_OK.
Commit the report separately, push operator/bridge-phase20-001, and do not merge it.
expected_outputs: Machine-enforced payload provenance and multi-pass lineage in .bridge/bridge_cli.py
constraints: Existing non-modeling and legacy single-pass tasks remain compatible.
Codex local modeling still requires explicit authorization.
No dependency installation, force push, or merge.
